caption: The drawing features a transparent, faceted container or vessel with a wide, flared base and a narrow neck, depicted in shades of light blue and gray. The vessel has a brass or gold-colored collar at the neck's top, from which two thin, vertical rods protrude. Attached to the neck is a single, large handle, with a wavy, looped form and rendered in similar light blue, gray, and white hues that suggest a glass material. To the right of the vessel, there is a separate, similarly colored handle, mirroring the shape and appearance of the handle attached to the vessel but shown as a distinct, unattached object. The background is an unadorned sepia or beige tone. Near the base of the vessel, the initials "M.A.R.S." are visible.
title: Whale Oil Lamp
